description: This source file defines the 'MessageTimeoutException' class, a custom exception used in the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that a message has exceeded its configured timeout. The class extends 'DittoRuntimeException' and implements 'MessageException', providing various constructors, factory methods, and a fluent builder for creating instances. It also includes mechanisms for JSON deserialization and header management, contextualized within the Eclipse Ditto messaging framework.
